title: Demiwise Grill Mat 76x48in

comparisons.notes: Same Demiwise 76x48in black fiberglass under-grill mat (76"D x 48"W x 0.15"H); listed at $50.99 with no sold-out marker.

writeup: Demiwise's oversized 76 by 48 inch under-grill mat is down to $15.99 on Woot. It has a fiberglass core with a double-sided silicone coating and is built to protect decks and patios from grease and embers. Kitchen Haven lists the same mat at $50.99, and Woot only had about 5 left when we checked.
amazon_match_notes: Exact match on ASIN, MPN AQ-SKD7648BK-DE, UPC 758211218683, 76x48in, black.
